classification: All five failed cases use chmod restrictions as an unavailability fixture. UID 0 can still read mode 000 files and write mode 0500 directories. The snapshot store-unavailable cases therefore used a valid binding and reached only the synthetic provider stub. This does not demonstrate a production request-guard bypass.

repair: Test-only: create a real file-to-directory atomic publication collision through a scoped passthrough hook; record the actual OS error and restore exact original ciphertext. Use mode 0644 for the unavailable-file fixture, which the actual private-file guard rejects for every UID.
